extracted.intended_audience: natural philosophers, chymists, and learned readers interested in chemical/philosophical method
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and argumentative criteria for judging experimental and dialectical proofs about the number and nature of 'Elements' or 'Principles' of mixed bodies in natural philosophy/early chemistry. Focuses on what counts as satisfactory demonstration by experiment or reason.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer experiments over dialectical subtleties
rubrics_metrics.description: Those Dialectical subtleties... are wont much more to declare the wit of him that uses them, then increase the knowledge or remove the doubts of sober lovers of truth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arguments should rely on experimental phenomena rather than captious scholastic ratiocination; rhetorical or logical tricks may puzzle but seldom satisfy—experiments are more likely to resolve sensible doubts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define 'Element'/'Principle' clearly as primitive simple bodies
rubrics_metrics.description: Elements and Principles ... those primitive and simple Bodies of which the mixt ones are said to be composed, and into which they are ultimately resolved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agree on terminology before arguing; avoid wrangling about words but be explicit that 'element'/'principle' here denotes primitive, simple constituents of mixed bodies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experimental proof must show pre-existence of proposed ingredients
rubrics_metrics.description: It appears... that which he takes for Elementary Fire and Water, are made out of the Concrete; but it appears not that the Concrete was made up of Fire and Water.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An experiment that produces or reveals substances upon analysis does not suffice unless it demonstrates those substances were present in the body prior to the analysis rather than being produced by the analytic process itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prove the analyzer does not alter ingredients (fire as instrument)
rubrics_metrics.description: To make your Reasoning cogent, it must be first prov'd, that the fire do's only take the Elementary Ingredients asunder, without otherwise altering them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using a process (especially fire) to separate constituents, one must show that the process merely separates and does not chemically or materially alter ingredients (else emergent products cannot be taken as pre-existing elements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not rely on single or scant experiments; require multiple confirmatory trials
rubrics_metrics.description: These, as they are often fram'd in one week, are perhaps thought fit to be laughed at the next; and being built perhaps but upon two or three Experiments are destroyed by a third or fourth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hypotheses should be grounded in a sufficient number of diverse experiments; isolated or few experiments are fragile and may be overturned by further trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer obvious, sensible experiments appropriate to the doctrine
rubrics_metrics.description: I am not a little pleased to find that you are resolved on this occasion to insist rather on Experiments then Syllogismes... I wish therefore they would no longer delay his expected satisfaction... to lay down what should be all along understood by the word Principle or Element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experiments used to demonstrate elemental claims should be sensible and appropriate (e.g., burning wood as a clear analysis), not far-fetched, so that the phenomena can be apprehended by common observation as well as reasoning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish experiments that illustrate from those that demonstrate
rubrics_metrics.description: They employ Experiments rather to illustrate then to demonstrate their Doctrines, as Astronomers use Sphæres of pastboard, to descend to the capacities of such as must be taught by their senses, for want of being arriv'd to a clear apprehension of purely Mathematical Notions and Truths.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not accept experiments that merely make a doctrine more intelligible as proof; demand experiments that actually establish the claimed fact (demonstrative evidence), not merely pedagogical illustrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Require applicability across diverse substances (consistency)
rubrics_metrics.description: I shall not peremptorily deny, that from most of such mixt Bodies as partake either of Animal or Vegetable Nature, there may by the Help of the Fire, be actually obtain'd a determinate number... But there are divers Bodies out of which Themistius will not prove in haste, that there can be so many Elements as four extracted by the Fire.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A theory about the number/nature of elements must account for a wide variety of materials; it is weak if it only works for some substances but fails for others (e.g., gold, silver resist the same analysis).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for variability in numbers of extracted substances
rubrics_metrics.description: There are others which may be reduc'd into more, as the Blood... which yield when analyz'd five distinct Substances, Phlegme, Spirit, Oyle, Salt and Earth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If analyses of different concretes yield different counts of constituents, the theory must explain why some bodies give three, four, five, or other numbers of substances rather than assuming a fixed small number universally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beware inferring elemental status from emergent or artifact products
rubrics_metrics.description: I have sometimes seen... some parcells of Glasse adhering to the Test or Cuppel, and this Glass though Emergent as well as the Gold or Litharge upon your Analysis, you will not I hope allow to have been a third Ingredient of the Mass out of which the fire produc'd it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not mistake substances formed or altered by the analytic process (e.g., glass adhering to crucible) for original ingredients of the analysed body.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theoretical claims should cohere with broader system of principles
rubrics_metrics.description: How harmonious Aristotle's Doctrine of the Elements is with his other Principles of Philosophy... they mutually strengthen and support each other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess candidate doctrines for internal coherence and how well they integrate with other accepted principles—mutual support across the system strengthens a theory's plausibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid rhetorical show; focus on argumentative substance
rubrics_metrics.description: The Rhetorical part of his Discourse, though it make not the least part of it, I shall say nothing to, designing to examine only the Argumentative part...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A good defence or proof emphasizes solid argumentative and experimental content over ornate rhetoric or grandiloquent address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be explicit about methodological limitations and promises
rubrics_metrics.description: My present business doth not oblige me so to declare my own opinion... but only to shew you that neither of these Doctrines hath been satisfactorily proved by the arguments commonly alledged on its behalfe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State clearly what is being argued, what concessions are (temporarily) made, and the precise limits of the present inquiry; do not conflate demonstration with skepticism or equivocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not assume a single instrument (fire) is universally adequate for analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: I shall have occasion to insist on, when I come to discourse with Philoponus concerning the right that fire has to pass for the proper and Universal Instrument of Analysing mixt Bodies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Question whether a single analytic method is universally reliable; consider alternative techniques and show why (or why not) they yield comparable results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for corpuscular/structural explanations (clusters/particles)
rubrics_metrics.description: It seems not absurd to conceive... the Universal Matter... was actually divided into little Particles of several sizes and shapes variously mov'd... divers of the smallest and neighbouring ones were here and there associated into minute Masses or Clusters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Theorize about possible microscopic structure (sizes, shapes, clusters) that could explain macroscopic diversity of compounds; use experiments (e.g., metallurgy, separations, recoveries) that are consistent with such corpuscular explanations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use recoverability of substances as evidence of persistence of constituent nature
rubrics_metrics.description: Out of all these exotick Compounds, we may recover the very same running Mercury that was the main Ingredient of them... we may recover the very same... Gold... we may recover the very same numerical, Yellow, Fixt, Ponderous and Malleable Gold it was before its commixture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrations that an original substance can be recovered unchanged from diverse compounds support the claim that it is a persistent constituent (a candidate for an elementary corpuscle/cluster).

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not let nominal disputes distract from substantive proof
rubrics_metrics.description: When I said, without very much Inconvenience, I had in my Thoughts that sober Admonition of Galen, Cum de re constat, de verbis non est Litigandum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid getting bogged down in terminological disputes when the substantive facts or experiments are agreed upon; focus on what the phenomena show rather than names.

rubrics_metrics.name: When arguing from analogy or system, make the linkage explicit
rubrics_metrics.description: For that great Man in his vast and comprehensive Intellect, so fram'd each of his Notions, that being curiously adapted into one Systeme, they need not each of them any other defence then that which their mutuall Coherence gives them: As 'tis in an Arch...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a doctrine's plausibility is supported by analogy or systemic fit, explicitly show how each part supports the others rather than merely asserting harmony.
